lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five distinguishable vertical columns and four horizontal rows, forming a coordinate-like array on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, particularly noticeable in the region between the gill slits and the first dorsal fin, defining a structured grid topology.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Visible as three parallel horizontal lines of high local contrast along the upper third of the flank; the uppermost ridge follows the dorsal contour, while two lower ridges exhibit sharp light-to-shadow transitions.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A cluster of approximately 12-15 discrete white spots is distributed across the first dorsal fin lateral surface, with higher spatial density observed towards the fin posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish attached or swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface and the right pectoral fin.
